notes: There is no default Jira project: create needs --jira-project KEY or "project" in ./.jira-team-kit/conventions.json; pull and push take it from the epic key.
The area goes as a [AREA] title prefix; components are not used (PLATE is shared and classified as api/mcp/mfe).
PLATE has no story points field on its edit screen: estimates are not sent.
Jira levels: Epic (1) > Story (migrated) | Tarea | Error (0, siblings) > Subtarea (-1).
Grouping uses Jira status categories (To Do / In Progress / Done), never status names; blocked = a status in blocked_statuses or the Flagged field set.
Reports (jtk done|next|blocked|load|stats) read Jira live. wip_limit (optional, a number) turns jtk load into a verdict; without it the command shows only measured numbers.
